column1: Jake McCarthy leads the slate with a strong hit probability and benefits from a top-of-the-order role at home, plus a favorable park boost and platoon advantage against Michael Wacha. Luis Arraez remains a steady option, consistently recording hits and also enjoying a platoon edge. Jackson Chourio and Jeremy Pena offer reliable floor but lack the same combination of matchup and environment. McCarthy stands out as the safest pick for Beat The Streak players tonight.
